QuestInfo.name: Deliver the Tattered Map to Black Bark
QuestInfo.0: I wonder what it is that Bartol wants me to do.
QuestInfo.1: I should deliver this #bTattered Map#k to #bBlack Bark#k in the #bCentral Conference Room of The Nautilus#k.
QuestInfo.2: I've delivered the Tattered Map to Black Bark.

0.0: First, give this ripped piece of the map to Black Bark.

yes.0: This map was found in the treasure chest that was discovered yesterday, and... I think Black Bark would really love this. Who knows, this map may lead to lots of treasures you know. Black Bark is always at the #bmeeting room in the middle hallway of The Nautilus#k, so go see him.
yes.1: Do the three favors I asked you to do, and you'll get the Warp Card. Keep going!

no.0: You don't feel like doing it anymore?

1.0: Bartol told you to give this map to you? Ohh, so this is a very old map.

yes.0: In fact, it is so ancient that the way they used symbols and outlines here looks like this map is at least a few hundred years ago. This really is making me feel excited about the maps. Hahaha, thank you so much for the find, and tell Bartol I said hello, too.

npc.0: Please give this map to Black Bark.

item.0: Are you here to learn how to read the map from me?

lost.0: You lost it, right? I just picked these off the floor, you know. Don't lose it, because it's a very precious item, and give it to Black Bark.
